testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.quests.tab.DropViewerTests

testcase.name: a Deadman Task pays once, only the valid PvP judge counts a kill, the points stop at the maximum
N279 N315 N304 - groups with headings in the Wiki's order, Extra rolls under Pets, the rarest first on Your chance
a skulled minute counts only while the skull counts down in a dangerous area - never standing still or in a guarded city
a guaranteed line with a quantity range drops on every kill and shows in the Always bar
N279 - an item's group is its own category from the item definition, the doubtful ones from the fixed list
the server reads the same sprite list the cache import wrote - same names, same sizes, so every id matches
an old save without the new attributes loads as empty - no kills of its own, empty log, no favourites, no tasks
chance notation and rarity colours follow the design
N307 N312 N311 - the breach emblem says once per breach on its own line in the bar, Chest reward explains itself, bodyguards under their general
the Deadman's Chest shows its own loc model - the closed chest's first model from the loc config
favourites and recently viewed are kept on the account
N309 N315 N317 N308 - Qty fits 46 px with thousands as K, (noted) leaves the name, no tick, Normal on a lighter band
N313 N306 - a boss pet shows the OSRS chance as Normal and the bracket-boosted chance as Your chance, a breach boss its own pet, no chest pet in a breach
N279 - every drop table is open, its lines right under it, a heading over every group
chances are the roll's own - lineChances at the player's rate and at 1x, a fold rolled at 1x inside
N282 - no picture in the log, the viewer or the tab gets a count from the client - only the real counter shows
the collection log records only log items, with the kill count, and says so once
the item picture is drawn for the largest quantity so stacks show their stack picture
N268 N316 N306 N293 - chest and breach pages weapons and armour first and the pets at the bottom, no boss pet in the chest, breach only its bosses' pets, no Zaryte bow, Pest Control on Minigames
actual fire ruby is on the Infernal Mage log page and records only from that source
